title: FactoryBench: Evaluating Industrial Machine Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2605.07675v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce FactoryBench, a benchmark for evaluating time-series models and LLMs on machine understanding over industrial robotic telemetry. Q&A pairs are organized along four causal levels (state, intervention, counterfactual, decision) instantiating Pearl's ladder of causation, and span five answer formats: four structured formats are scored deterministically and free-form answers are scored by an LLM-as-judge voting protocol. We propose a scalable Q&A generation framework built around structured question templates, present FactoryWave (a dense, multitask, multivariate sensor dataset collected from a UR3 cobot and a KUKA KR10 industrial arm), and construct FactoryBench as a large-scale benchmark of over 70k Q&A items grounded in roughly 15k normalized episodes from FactoryWave, AURSAD, and voraus-AD. Zero-shot evaluation of six frontier LLMs shows that no model exceeds 50% on structured levels or 18% on decision-making, revealing

translated_title: FactoryBench：评估工业机器理解能力
translated_abstract: 我们推出了FactoryBench，一个用于评估时间序列模型和大语言模型（LLM）在工业机器人遥测数据上机器理解能力的基准。问答对按照四个因果层级（状态、干预、反事实、决策）组织，实例化了珀尔的因果阶梯，并涵盖五种答案格式：其中四种结构化格式采用确定性评分，自由形式答案则通过“大模型作为裁判”的投票协议进行评分。我们提出了一个围绕结构化问题模板构建的可扩展问答生成框架，介绍了FactoryWave（一个从UR3协作机器人和KUKA KR10工业机械臂采集的密集、多任务、多变量传感器数据集），并基于来自FactoryWave、AURSAD和voraus-AD的约1.5万个规范化回合，构建了包含超过7万个问答项的大规模基准FactoryBench。对六个前沿大语言模型的零样本评估表明，没有任何模型在结构化层级上超过50%，在决策任务上不超过18%，揭示了……
tldr: FactoryBench基于珀尔因果阶梯构建了四个因果层级的问答基准，包含7万余个问答项，用于评估时间序列模型和大语言模型对工业机器人遥测数据的理解能力，零样本评测显示当前前沿大语言模型在结构化任务上不超过50%、在决策任务上不超过18%。
en_tdlr: FactoryBench is a large-scale benchmark of over 70k Q&A items that evaluates time-series models and LLMs on industrial robotic machine understanding across four causal levels of Pearl's ladder, and zero-shot evaluations of six frontier LLMs reveal that no model exceeds 50% on structured levels or 18% on decision-making.
